hypothesis: W-R24 structural missing-row heuristics fail with interpolation. Instead identify true observed source rows by nearest four-channel circular alignment to the paired reference stream, retaining only high-confidence time-index mismatches. This could detect swapped observations despite interpolation without privileged missing-data flags.
freeze: Freeze row-alignment distance, circular time-index feature, confidence threshold=12, feature/model count, training/heldout fills, all seeds and outcome criteria before original first-use. No post-result threshold adjustment.
training: Exactly W-R24 generators on affine dev with all-four channel offset+17, jitter amp1/2, negative swaps tail2/3,5/6,8/9 and deterministic zero/carryforward/127 fill assignment, 2/4 missing ticks mask [1,5,8,11] (untouched swaps). 1728 paired samples/model, learning rate .1, 32 epochs and 16 trainable weights+bias, identical baseline and proposed budget.
heldout: Three existing affine/quadratic/xorshift generator families, unseen seeds336..351, global offset+79, amp3, two unseen local swaps tail10/11 and12/13, non-oracle fill policies constant73 and linear nearest-neighbor interpolation, mask counts2/4/6 at [1,4,7,9,15,6]. Exactly 36 heldout conditions per model.
alignment_feature: Estimate each channel's modulo256 offset from candidate first row (unmasked anchor) minus reference first row; for each candidate row t compute the mean circular absolute byte difference to each reference row u shifted by anchor offset, choose lowest error with deterministic first-u tie break; if minimum<=12, feature[t]=minimum circular time-index distance between t and u divided by 8, else feature[t]=0. Always exactly 16 features and 16 learned weights, no hidden labels/extra observations.
classification: ALIGNMENT_GENERALIZES if alignment holds accuracy>=.85 in EVERY heldout interpolation cell and constant73 cell and beats structural_fill aggregate by >=0.10; PARTIAL if alignment improves structural_fill pooled heldout by >=0.05 but strict result fails; NEGATIVE otherwise. Report per-condition confusion for each arm and every failure.
safety: Only existing paired 16x4 observations; deterministic 16x16x4 matching work explicitly budgeted, no external oracle. Exact prereg/source/parent identity, first-use evidence archive then full regression. No accepted-ref mutation, additional inference calls, hidden capacity or retries.
claim_limit: Synthetic four-channel temporal alignment; no general language reasoning.
